highlights: Attractive one-bedroom retirement apartment in the sought-after Churchill Living development, just moments from Penrith town centre.
Bright and spacious living/dining room opening onto a private patio seating area.
Stylish fitted kitchen with integrated appliances including oven, hob, fridge-freezer and washing machine.
Generous double bedroom with fitted wardrobe and modern shower room.
Enhanced accessibility with automatic door-opening system, video entry and 24-hour emergency call facility.
Superb residents’ facilities including landscaped gardens, owners’ lounge, guest suite and residents’ parking.
summary: Set in an excellent location, within easy level walking distance of the Penrith town centre, in a purpose built retirement and fully managed development for the over 60's, a well-proportioned and presented, low maintenance, 1 bedroom ground floor apartment with direct access to patio seating area.
description:
Built and professionally managed by Churchill Living, Dutton Lodge is an attractive and well-maintained retirement development, ideally positioned within easy reach of the excellent shops, services and amenities of Penrith town centre.

Designed specifically for independent retirement living, the development benefits from a Lodge Manager available during office hours, together with a welcoming residents' lounge that hosts a variety of social activities and events, creating a friendly and supportive community environment.

The apartment itself is thoughtfully arranged and offers generous built-in storage throughout. The accommodation comprises a bright and spacious living/dining room with direct access to a private patio seating area, providing an ideal space to relax and enjoy the surroundings. Adjoining the living area is a well-equipped fitted kitchen featuring integrated appliances including an oven, hob, fridge-freezer and washing / dryer machine.

There is a comfortable double bedroom with a built-in wardrobe, together with a modern shower room.

For added peace of mind, the apartment is fitted with a video entry system and a 24-hour emergency call facility. A bespoke automatic door-opening system has also been installed, making the property particularly well suited to wheelchair users and those seeking enhanced accessibility.

Set within beautifully landscaped and maintained communal gardens, the development also offers residents' parking on a first-come, first-served basis, allowing owners to retain the convenience of a private vehicle. In addition, a guest suite is available for visiting family and friends to hire, subject to availability, providing comfortable overnight accommodation close at hand. Pets may be by negotiation.

Directions From the town centre follow the A6 south on King St, taking the left turn just past the John Norris outdoor shop onto Roper Street. Go past Whelpdale House and Dutton Lodge is on the left hand side.

Services Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is in a communal car park (without allocated spaces) • Dutton Lodge requires at least one apartment resident to be over the age of 60 with any second resident over the age of 55.

• Tenure: The property is sold on a leasehold basis, a 999 year lease having been granted in November 2021. There is a combined service charge and ground rent circa £3824.08 per annum. The service charges include: Careline system, buildings insurance, water and sewerage rates, ground source heating, communal cleaning, utilities and maintenance, garden maintenance, lift maintenance, Lodge Manager and a contribution to the contingency fund.
